prompt.text: Prova tecnica fuori dal gioco: i comandi del server chesspal si chiamano attraverso lo strumento execute. Chiama così il comando status di chesspal e dimmi in una riga la lingua della campagna.

content.text:
Offer the player their dashboard's link in your first answer: http://127.0.0.1:4747.
Banco T-260 · it · free, free play, without a game system · mode setup
Still to agree with the player: outcomes (told, rolled or tossed), mentor (ask how well the player knows the game: never played, tutorial; a little, hints; well, off), premise (the genre, the tone, a few elements of the world and what the player enjoys most in a game, such as fights, mysteries, talk or exploring, in the player's words), preparation (on the fly: the world made just before it is needed; all at the start), length (how long it plays: one evening; a few sessions; open, one adventure after another), difficulty (how hard the world plays: story, easy, normal, hard, brutal), lethality (what a fall means: narrative, the character never dies; epic, only when it matters; dice, the dice decide), saves (when the game may go back: permadeath, never but to the start; checkpoint, to the last end of a scene once the player character dies; free, to any save), dice (who rolls the player character's dice: digital, chesspal; physical, the player, who tells you the values), master-rolls (your rolls for foes and NPCs: behind the screen, in view; suggest behind the screen), units (metric, imperial), character (made with the player; made by the master, from a few words; the player's own, one they bring), companions (none, made with the player, made by the master, met in play), calendar-start (when the story starts: day 1 to count only the days, or a day of the world, such as 14 April 1491), pictures (of places, quests and those met: none; on request; new elements, one for each), pictures-by (who makes them: chat, your app by its own means; codex; antigravity; elevenlabs; other, a tool the player names, written by its name; suggest chat), lines ("none" is an answer), veils ("none" is an answer); set each with config. In their last campaign the player chose preparation on the fly, length one evening, difficulty normal, lethality epic, saves free, dice digital, master-rolls behind the screen, units metric, companions none: offer those first. When none is left and the player confirms: mode, to "session zero". The player can make the setup's choices on the dashboard, one at a time: offer it, and meanwhile ask in the chat only the game system, the premise, the language and when the story starts. Ask the rest only when they leave it to you, or once they say they are ready.
No player character yet. The system free keeps on a character sheet, by these names: concept, abilities; and when they apply: factions, money, inventory.
Pictures: you can draw the pictures of places, quests and those met yourself, as simple vector pictures, which spends their plan: ask them once whether they want one for each new place, quest and one met, only those they ask for, or none; then config pictures (new elements, on request or none).

Write nothing to the player until your message is ready: your first words are the opening itself.


Il testo qui sopra sta dietro lo schermo del master, proibito agli occhi dei giocatori.
